headline: Executive order signed January 18, 2021, addressing who is accountable when federal agencies write rules.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal agencies make rules and who is responsible for approving them. The title suggests it aims to tie agency rulemaking more closely to officials who answer to elected leaders. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to set expectations for how agencies handle and approve new rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 18, 2021; the source material gives no separate effective date.
